payload.title: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-002: Parse PR–issue linkage and guard untrusted forks
payload.body:
## Summary

Implement documented rules for detecting linked GitHub Issues from the **PR body** (`Fixes` / `Closes` / `Refs`), skip expensive work when none exist, post a short **guidance comment** for authors, and apply the **fork/untrusted PR** policy so secrets are not exposed to arbitrary forks.

## Scope

- In scope: Parsing policy (documented), early exit with guidance when no parseable issue ref, optional workflow `if:` for same-repo PRs only (or equivalent documented policy).
- Out of scope: Parsing issue refs from commit messages (PRD: v1 PR body only unless extended later).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a PR whose body has **no** parseable `Fixes` / `Closes` / `Refs` issue reference, when the workflow runs, then **no paid LLM request** is made and the author sees a **short comment** explaining how to link an issue.
- [ ] Given a PR whose body contains a valid closing/reference form (per documented policy), when the workflow runs, then at least one issue number is extracted for downstream fetching.
- [ ] **Fork policy** is implemented as specified in repo docs (e.g. skip LLM path when `head.repo` is not the same as base, or documented alternative) so fork PRs do not use org LLM secrets inappropriately.
- [ ] Parsing rules and fork behavior are documented in the same place maintainers copy the workflow from.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none (comment posting may reuse GitHub integration from GHA-PR-LLM-AC-001 — coordinate to avoid duplicate clients)
- Blocks: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005

## Notes

PRD advisory mode: guidance comment is the product behavior for missing linkage, not a failing required check.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/pr-github-llm-ticket-acceptance.prd.md
